contribution.summary: Close Math Foundation-only source cross-SDK GREEN from RS329 first-pass proof and ready Verification, preserving all other Math migration limits.
contribution.value: RS329 succeeded first-pass on attempt 001 using DWF 0.1.72 and guidance 0.27. Its isolated source-only Foundation probe compiled identical one-file public contract source under SDK 10/net10/C#14 and SDK 11.0.100/net11/C#15 and observed the same exact PackageId, ContractVersion and Identity. It refused two copied-net11-only contract/version and package-ID changes, restored exact source bytes, and preserved original Math source and SDK configuration. Close only C02/T1 GREEN for this one bounded Foundation public-contract proof; ready T1 Verification without starting it. Other twelve libraries lack this source parity proof, all thirteen API semantic compatibility verdicts remain unqualified and ten published package closures remain unqualified. The production migration blocker stays not-granted; no new C#15 syntax, public NuGet package or SDK change is implied.
